The '''Vandalar City police station''' was located on the lower levels of [[Vandalar City]]. The survivors of the [[Hurt Vectors]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] were turned in here by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].
